I plan to make a website that gathers data from the NCAA website to help people find out more about the statistics of a team winning and takedown chances. 

## Top 10 teams by year

Each point shows a team's championship points for that year, with the school logo and team name. Hover over a point for the coach and exact values. Click a logo to open the official NCAA brackets/results for that season; for 2015–2021, the link opens the NCAA championship history archive. Rankings and points are from the [NCAA Division I wrestling records](https://s3.amazonaws.com/fs.ncaa.org/Docs/stats/wrestling_champs_records/D1.pdf); logos are loaded from official athletics sites and their image CDNs.

```{r}
    results_url = coalesce(
      unname(ncaa_results_url[as.character(year)]),
      "https://www.ncaa.com/history/wrestling-men/d1"
    )

  group_by(year, points) |>
  mutate(logo_x = year + (row_number() - (n() + 1) / 2) * 0.24) |>
  ungroup()

logo_images <- logo_positions |>
  select(year, rank, team, points, coach, logo, logo_x) |>
  pmap(\(year, rank, team, points, coach, logo, logo_x) {
    list(
      source = logo,
      x = logo_x,
      y = points,
      xref = "x",
      yref = "y",
      sizex = 0.2,
      sizey = 4,
      xanchor = "center",
      yanchor = "middle",
      sizing = "contain",
      layer = "above"
    )
  })

team_results |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~year,
    y = ~points,
    color = ~team,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers+text",
    marker = list(size = 17, opacity = 0.8),
    text = ~team,
    textposition = "top right",
    customdata = ~coach,
    hovertemplate = "%{text}<br>Coach: %{customdata}<br>Year: %{x}<br>Points: %{y}<extra></extra>",
    showlegend = TRUE
  ) |>
  layout(
    title = "Top 10 NCAA Division I team points by year (2015–2025)",
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Year",
      tickmode = "array",
      tickvals = 2015:2025,
      range = c(2014.5, 2025.5)
    ),
    yaxis = list(title = "Championship points"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Team")),
    height = 950,
    images = logo_images
  ) |>
  add_trace(
    data = logo_positions,
    x = ~logo_x,
    y = ~points,
    text = ~paste(team, year, sep = " — "),
    customdata = ~results_url,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    marker = list(size = 44, color = "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.01)"),
    hovertemplate = paste(
      "<b>%{text}</b><br>",
      "Click to open official NCAA brackets/results",
      "<extra></extra>"
    ),
    name = "NCAA results link",
    showlegend = FALSE
  ) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      el.on('plotly_click', function(eventData) {
        var point = eventData.points[0];
        if (point.data.name === 'NCAA results link') {
          window.open(point.customdata, '_blank', 'noopener');
        }
      });
    }
  ")
```

## Wrestler wins and losses by weight

Choose a championship year and weight class to compare every wrestler in the
NCAA bracket by their season wins and losses. Click a point to view the
wrestler's record and links to a bio search and the official bracket. The
bracket data for 2022 and 2023–2025 are included; the 2020 tournament was
canceled. The 2022 records are from the
[official NCAA bracket PDF](https://www.ncaa.com/sites/default/files/public/files/2022-03/Brackets%20-%20Session%206.pdf).

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

wrestler_records <- readr::read_csv(
  "ncaa_wrestler_records.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

years <- sort(unique(wrestler_records$year), decreasing = TRUE)
weights <- sort(unique(wrestler_records$weight))
default_year <- years[1]
default_weight <- weights[1]
wrestler_chart <- plot_ly()

for (current_year in years) {
  for (current_weight in weights) {
    weight_data <- wrestler_records |>
      filter(year == current_year, weight == current_weight) |>
      mutate(
        bio_url = paste0(
          "https://en.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?search=",
          utils::URLencode(wrestler, reserved = TRUE)
        ),
        bio = paste0(
          wrestler, " (", school_code, ") — ", current_year, ", ",
          current_weight, " lb. Season record: ", wins, "-", losses, "."
        ),
        click_data = paste(bio, bio_url, source, sep = "|")
      )

    wrestler_chart <- wrestler_chart |>
      add_trace(
        x = weight_data$wins,
        y = weight_data$losses,
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "markers",
        text = weight_data$wrestler,
        customdata = weight_data$click_data,
        marker = list(size = 9, color = "#2c7fb8", opacity = 0.75),
        hovertemplate = paste(
          "<b>%{text}</b> (", current_weight, " lb)<br>",
          "Season record: %{x} wins, %{y} losses<br>",
          "Click for wrestler details",
          "<extra></extra>"
        ),
        name = paste(current_year, current_weight, "lb"),
        visible = current_year == default_year && current_weight == default_weight,
        showlegend = FALSE
      )
  }
}

htmltools::tags$div(
  class = "wrestler-chart-controls",
  htmltools::tags$label(
    `for` = "wrestler-year",
    htmltools::tags$span("Championship year"),
    htmltools::tags$select(
      id = "wrestler-year",
      lapply(years, \(year) {
        htmltools::tags$option(
          value = year,
          selected = year == default_year,
          year
        )
      })
    )
  ),
  htmltools::tags$span(" "),
  htmltools::tags$label(
    `for` = "wrestler-weight",
    htmltools::tags$span("Weight class"),
    htmltools::tags$select(
      id = "wrestler-weight",
      lapply(weights, \(weight) {
        htmltools::tags$option(
          value = weight,
          selected = weight == default_weight,
          paste(weight, "lb")
        )
      })
    )
  )
)

htmltools::tags$div(
  id = "wrestler-bio",
  style = paste(
    "display:none; margin: 0.75rem 0; padding: 1rem;",
    "border-left: 4px solid #2c7fb8; background: #f3f7fa;"
  ),
  htmltools::tags$strong(id = "wrestler-bio-title"),
  htmltools::tags$p(id = "wrestler-bio-details"),
  htmltools::tags$a(
    id = "wrestler-bio-link",
    href = "#",
    target = "_blank",
    rel = "noopener",
    "Find wrestler bio"
  ),
  htmltools::tags$span(" · "),
  htmltools::tags$a(
    id = "wrestler-bio-source",
    href = "#",
    target = "_blank",
    rel = "noopener",
    "Open official NCAA bracket"
  )
)

wrestler_chart |>
  layout(
    title = paste0("NCAA participants — ", default_year, ", ", default_weight, " lb"),
    xaxis = list(title = "Season wins", rangemode = "tozero"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Season losses", rangemode = "tozero"),
    height = 600
  ) |>
  htmlwidgets::onRender("
    function(el, x) {
      var yearSelect = document.getElementById('wrestler-year');
      var weightSelect = document.getElementById('wrestler-weight');
      function updateChart() {
        var selectedYear = yearSelect.value;
        var selectedWeight = weightSelect.value;
        var visibility = el.data.map(function(trace) {
          return trace.name === selectedYear + ' ' + selectedWeight + ' lb';
        });
        Plotly.restyle(el, {visible: visibility});
        Plotly.relayout(el, {
          'title.text': 'NCAA participants — ' + selectedYear + ', ' + selectedWeight + ' lb'
        });
      }
      yearSelect.addEventListener('change', updateChart);
      weightSelect.addEventListener('change', updateChart);
      el.on('plotly_click', function(eventData) {
        var point = eventData.points[0];
        var details = point.data.customdata[point.pointNumber].split('|');
        var panel = document.getElementById('wrestler-bio');
        document.getElementById('wrestler-bio-title').textContent = point.text;
        document.getElementById('wrestler-bio-details').textContent = details[0];
        document.getElementById('wrestler-bio-link').href = details[1];
        document.getElementById('wrestler-bio-source').href = details[2];
        panel.style.display = 'block';
      });
    }
  ")
```

## Division II and III championship points

The Division II scatterplot compares the champion and runner-up from each of the
last 10 completed championships (2015–2025; the 2020 championship was canceled).
Scores are from the [NCAA Division II championship history](https://www.ncaa.com/history/wrestling-men/d2).
Hover over a point for the team, placement, and points.

The Division III chart shows the top two scoring positions at each completed
championship since 2015, including all teams tied for a position. The 2020 and
2021 championships were canceled. Scores are from the
[NCAA Division III championship history](https://www.ncaa.com/history/wrestling-men/d3).
